In the absence of an Appropriate Assessment Screening for the proposed development and the potential adverse impact on Natura 2000 site, namely Derravaragh Special Protected Area (SPA) (site code 004043), either individually or cumulatively, it is considered that there is potential for significant effects on the Natura 2000 network arising from the proposed works either alone or in combination with other plans and/or projects by way of loss, fragmentation, disruption, disturbance to habitats, species or habitats of species that are of conservation interest. decision_text: The Louth County Development Plan 2021-2027 (as varied) is the operation plan for the area. The objective for this zoning is to conserve and enhance the quality and character of established residential communities and protect their amenities.
